title: DetFill-with-DHT: Deterministic Hints and Hint-AUC for Line Art Colorization (code, reproduction package)
description:
Code accompanying the paper Hint-AUC: Deterministic Region-based Hint Generation for Line Art Colorization Evaluation (IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics, 2026, DOI 10.1109/TVCG.2026.3738401): the deterministic hint generator DHT and the hintauc evaluation library, the DetFill diffusion colorization model, the per-ratio metric files and scripts that rebuild the paper's tables, and the one-command replicability script for Figure 9 (bash replicability/run.sh).

This archive holds the repository at tag grsi-1.0, the state reviewed for the Graphics Replicability Stamp. Model checkpoints and the released data files are distributed through the GitHub releases v1.0-v1.4 of the repository and are not part of this archive.
